skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the concept and principles of ISA.
Explain the operation model of RISC architecture.
Apply Amdahl's law to determine the best improvement and differentiate between cache size and clock frequency.
Differentiate between direct and set-associative cache mapping.
Identify and explain structural, data, and control hazards in pipeline design.
Understand and apply parallelism techniques at the instruction level.
Design memory hierarchy including cache, main memory, and virtual memory.
Understand and analyze multi-core CPU architectures.
Apply quantitative design principles in computer architecture.
Develop problem-solving skills specific to computer architecture.
Collaborate effectively in teams to solve problems within deadlines.
Demonstrate ability to learn independently and manage group work.
Maintain classroom discipline and adhere to class rules.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve problems.
Communicate effectively in class discussions and presentations.
